name: Guardian Domain
body:
Granted Powers: The power of your faith establishes a bond between you and a guardian spirit (such as an archon or a nature spirit). The guardian spirit’s spiritual blessings safeguards you from harm, reinforces your ability to guard others from harm, and teaches you how to drive back extraplanar threats. You receive a +1 sacred bonus to your AC. This bonus increases by 1 for every 5 levels you possess.

Protective Touch (Sp)

As a standard action, you can touch an ally to grant them the sacred bonus granted by the guardian domain for 1 minute. When you use this ability, you lose your sacred bonus granted by the guardian domain for 1 minute. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Guardian’s Aura (Su)

At 8th level, you can emit a 30-foot divine aura that weakens your enemies and guards your allies as a standard action. All enemies within the range of this divine aura take a -2 penalty to their attack rolls. Within this divine aura, you and your allies gain a resistance bonus to all saving throws and energy resistance against the elements (acid, cold, electricity, fire, and sonic) equal to the sacred bonus you gain from the granted power of the guardian domain. At 14th level, the value of the imposed penalty and the energy resistance from this ability are doubled. You can use this ability for a number of rounds each day equal to your cleric level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Domain Spells: 1st-line in the sand; 2nd-reinvigorating wind; 3rd-substitutionary idol; 4th–primal scream; 5th-banishing blade; 6th–antimagic field; 7th–repulsion; 8th-champion’s shout; 9th–antipathy.
